products.title: Carbon Steel Grill Wok w/ Bamboo Spatula
products.body_html:
The Carbon Steel Wok is a versatile addition to your outdoor cooking arsenal. This 17-inch (43 cm) wok delivers rapid, even heating for authentic stir-fries, searing, and more. Dual handles ensure confident maneuvering, while the sloped sides facilitate effortless tossing and keep ingredients centered over intense heat. Seamlessly integrating with the EGGspander system, it expands your outdoor cooking repertoire.

  • 18-gauge carbon steel construction
  • Flat bottom compatible with all cooktop types
  • Includes bamboo spatula for precise ingredient control
  • Pre-seasoned for immediate use

The wok's adaptability makes it a go-to tool for both novice cooks and seasoned chefs. Its durability and heat retention properties ensure consistent results, meal after meal. By adding this wok to your egg setup, you join a community of passionate outdoor cooks who value versatility and flavor in equal measure.

products.title: Enameled Cast Iron Dutch Oven
products.body_html:
This 5.5-quart (5.2-liter) enameled cast iron Dutch oven offers exceptional heat retention and distribution for consistent cooking results. Its versatility allows for slow-cooking, braising, roasting, or baking. The durable enamel surface resists sticking and cleans effortlessly, while the heavy-duty construction withstands temperatures up to 450°F (232°C). Large handles provide secure grip, and the ingenious lid doubles as a shallow baking dish.

  • Compatible with 2XL, XL, and L egg cookers
  • Heat-resistant to 450°F (232°C)
  • Dishwasher safe
  • Weight: 14.3 lbs (6.5 kg)

This Dutch oven seamlessly integrates with your outdoor cooking system, expanding your culinary possibilities. Its quality construction and thoughtful design make it an essential tool for creating everything from hearty stews to delectable cobblers, enhancing your egg-to-table experience with every use.

products.title: Cast Iron Sauce Pot w/ Basting Brush
products.body_html:
The Cast Iron Sauce Pot with Silicone Brush is a versatile tool for outdoor cooking enthusiasts. This robust 8 oz (236 ml) pot effortlessly melts butter, warms marinades, and heats sauces to perfection. The integrated BPA-free silicone brush, nestled conveniently in the handle, ensures precise and mess-free basting. Weighing just 1.2 lbs (0.54 kg), this versatile tool becomes an indispensable part of your grilling arsenal, enhancing flavors and simplifying your cooking process.

  • Dimensions: 3.5" x 6" x 3" (8.9 cm x 15.2 cm x 7.6 cm)
  • Temperature range: Up to 500°F (260°C)
  • Materials: Cast iron pot, silicone brush head, wooden handle

Care instructions:

  • Pot: Hand wash with water only; dry immediately and lightly oil after use
  • Silicone brush head: Dishwasher safe
  • Handle: Hand wash with mild soap; do not dishwash

products.title: Skillet - Cast Iron - Pre Seasoned 14"/36 cm
products.body_html:
Perfect for searing, braising, baking, sautéing or roasting … this Cast Iron Skillet will delight you with the results! Use in your EGG for everything from seared steaks and seafood, braised meats, casseroles and gratins to cornbread, biscuits and cobblers. products.title: XL Durable Drip Tray Kit
products.body_html:
Catch the drips. Skip the mess. Wash and repeat. The Big Green Egg Durable Drip Tray Kit is designed for performance and everyday versatility. These reusable stainless steel drip trays are built to handle high-heat cooks and repeated use without warping or wearing out.

More than a smarter alternative to disposable foil pans, they reflect our commitment to sustainability by reducing waste and delivering a long-lasting solution. The split-tray design delivers full coverage and flexible placement for both dual-zone and indirect cooking setups, so you can cook with more control—and less cleanup.

Sustainable Cost Savings: Save money over time with sturdy, reusable drip pans that last. Simply clean and they’re ready for the next cook.

Dishwasher Safe: Made with polished, durable stainless steel, the nesting shapes can be separated easily, emptied, cleaned in the dishwasher, and conveniently stored for the next use.

Lacing and Nesting: Patent pending overlapping lips form a full circle to catch drips during indirect cooks — or split apart for dual-zone setups, catching drips on one side while you cook direct on the other.

products.title: Dual Zone™ Cooking Grid
products.body_html:
Greater flexibility. More control. The Dual Zone™ Cooking Grid lets you better manage dual zone cooks when used with the Dual Zone™ Deflector Kit. Move one half-moon without disturbing food on the other, to more easily adjust a deflector plate, more charcoal, or add smoking chunks mid-cook. A crossbar-free design simplifies cleanup, while heavy-gauge 304 stainless steel delivers better heat retention and years of dependable performance.

Access Without Disruption: Move one half-moon without disturbing the other. Access charcoal, add smoking chunks, or manage dual-zone cooking when paired with the Dual Zone™ Deflector Kit.
Superior Searing: Heavy-gauge wire absorbs and holds more heat for beautiful sear marks and consistent temperatures across surface cooking grid.
Quicker Clean Up: Crossbar-free construction lets your grill brush reach more of the cooking surface with every pass.

Note: For proper fitment, Dual Zone™ Cooking Grids should be used with the Dual Zone™ Deflector Kit.
